headline.text: L1 S1 live cockroach found on finished-product pallet at *22:54* — pallet pulled, area inspection ordered.

summary: One active pest sighting at L1 requiring follow-up inspection. Foreign material caught at checkweigher on L1 S3. Metal detector at L1 S1 opened extra times beyond test protocol. L3 truffles scrapped 8 bins for damage.

holds.title: 8 bins truffles scrapped for damage
holds.summary: QA ordered 8 of 12 accumulated bins scrapped because chocolate was heavily scuffed and damaged.
holds.status: Resolved — bins scrapped per QA direction.

food_safety.title: Live cockroach on S1 finished-product pallet
food_safety.summary: Employee reported live cockroach on pallet at 22:54; pallet removed for inspection and insect disposal.
food_safety.status: Open — pallet pulled, maintenance ordered to inspect area for additional insects.

food_safety.title: Plastic part in S3 bag rejected at checkweigher
food_safety.summary: Piece fell from MM4 top into bag during packing; rejected at checkweigh station due to excess weight, part recovered.
food_safety.status: Resolved — foreign material rejected by weight check, QC notified part was found.

food_safety.title: S1 metal detector opened extra times after test
food_safety.summary: During 13:30 and 14:30 checks, MD test cards detected correctly but detector opened 1–2 additional times afterward each check; did not open again after 14:30.
food_safety.status: Resolved — no further anomalies after 14:30 check; monitoring continues.

quality.title: ML4 dirty molds not auto-rejecting
quality.summary: Bars coming out with small stains from dirty molds that vision system is not catching; team manually removing affected molds.
quality.status: Open — investigating vision sensitivity adjustment to auto-reject dirty molds.

opportunities.text: Consider adding metal detector self-test log to capture spurious openings — based on S1 MD opening extra times beyond test protocol on 9/28.
Consider scheduling pest control sweep of S1 pack area — based on live cockroach sighting on finished-product pallet at 22:54.
Consider recalibrating ML4 vision rejection threshold for dirty molds — based on stained bars passing inspection that required manual removal.
